name: Zhang Jiabao
source:
"I guarantee you won't be disappointed."

Zhang Jiabao is a high-ranking member of the Qingyun Society, and one of [url=/c7183]Liu Haojun[/url]'s top lieutenants. He is the most successful pimp in Shanghai. A Waijia master known as the "Six Vajra" for his lightning fast strikes, surpassing the limits of human dynamic vision.

One of the five responsible for [url=/c7182]Kong Ruili[/url]'s rape and murder.
